verbalization: The visible evidence suggests a potential relationship between 3beta,30-Dihydroxylup-20(29)-en-28-oic acid and the EZH2/SUZ12/EED complex, mediated through a chain of targets. The compound is directly linked to Solute carrier family 22 member 7, which is a known target of Thaliglucinone. Thaliglucinone, in turn, is implicated in targeting the EZH2/SUZ12/EED complex. This suggests a possible pathway where the compound may influence the activity of Solute carrier family 22 member 7, which then interacts with Thaliglucinone, ultimately affecting the EZH2/SUZ12/EED complex. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, though the exact nature of the interaction remains unclear. The integration of these targets highlights the compound's potential role in modulating epigenetic processes through this pathway.
